title: IBM Engineering AI Hub 1.0.0 through 1.4.0 could allow a remote attacker to obtain sensitive information and perform…
description: IBM Engineering AI Hub versions 1.0.0 through 1.4.0 contain a vulnerability due to improper validation of redirect URLs. This flaw could allow a remote attacker to obtain sensitive information and perform unauthorized actions. The vulnerability is classified under CWE-601 (Open Redirect).
